resting_heart_rate_bpm.note: NASA-STD-3001 / clinical resting range; in-flight resting HR often lower

sleep_hours.note: NASA recommends 8h sleep opportunity; <6h impairs performance

stress_score.note: App-defined 0-100 composite; calibrate per crew baseline

blood_pressure_systolic_mmhg.note: Clinical resting range; in-flight BP trends matter more than single readings

body_temperature_c.note: Fever threshold 38.0 C; core temp can run slightly higher in flight

mood_score_1_10.note: Self-reported daily mood, 1-10; low mood is an early behavioral-health signal

steps_per_day.note: In-flight exercise countermeasure target ~2.5h/day; steps are a proxy only

lab_panels.note: Reference ranges come with the OSDR data itself (ref_min/ref_max per indicator); flag low/high vs those ranges
